ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Jusched.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "jusched.exe" as seen used by the cobalt group

sequences.query: (process_description = "Java\ Update\ Scheduler" OR process_description = "Java\(TM\)\ Update\ Scheduler") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\jusched\\\.exe$"))
